@@ -0,0 +1,460 @@

+#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"
+
+/* VP9 idct_idct 8x8 / 16x16 / 32x32 add, RVV.
+ * C reference: vp9dsp_template.c (idct8_1d / idct16_1d / idct32_1d +
+ * itxfm_wrapper).
+ *
+ * Both 1-D passes are the same butterfly, applied lane-wise:
+ * - Pass 1 (rows): load the block as COLUMN vectors (vlse16, stride =
+ *   row byte stride), so the row butterfly (pairs in[0]+in[4], in[1]+in[7],
+ *   ...) becomes element-wise across the column vectors.  Results are
+ *   stored column-wise into a stack tmp[] (which reproduces the C
+ *   row-major intermediate), then the input block is zeroed (caller
+ *   contract, as in C).
+ * - Pass 2 (columns): reload the intermediate as ROW vectors and apply the
+ *   same butterfly lane-wise; results are the final rows.
+ * - Accumulate: (out + (1<<(bits-1))) >> bits added to dst, clip to
+ *   [0, 255], per output row (8/16/32 bytes of dst).
+ *
+ * All arithmetic in e32 (products fit in int32 for 8-bit VP9:
+ * |in| <= 2^15, coefs <= 16069, sums stay below 2^31).  The >>14 rounding
+ * is (x + 8192) >> 14 via vadd.vx + vsra.vi; int16 intermediate
+ * truncation via vnsrl.wi matches the dctcoef (int16_t) storage in C.
+ *
+ * regs: v0..v7 inputs (e16/e32), v8..v24 temps, v16..v23 dst rows.
+ */
+
+/* idct8_1d lane-wise butterfly on v0..v7 (e32) -> v0..v7 (e32).
+ * Uses t5 as scalar temp. */
+.macro vp9_idct8_1d
+        /* t0a..t7a */
+        vadd.vv v8,  v0, v4
+        li      t5, 11585
+        vmul.vx v8,  v8, t5
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v8,  v8, t5
+        vsra.vi v8,  v8, 14          /* t0a */
+        vsub.vv v9,  v0, v4
+        li      t5, 11585
+        vmul.vx v9,  v9, t5
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v9,  v9, t5
+        vsra.vi v9,  v9, 14          /* t1a */
+        li      t5, 6270
+        vmul.vx v10, v2, t5
+        li      t5, 15137
+        vmul.vx v11, v6, t5
+        vsub.vv v10, v10, v11
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v10, v10, t5
+        vsra.vi v10, v10, 14         /* t2a */
+        li      t5, 15137
+        vmul.vx v11, v2, t5
+        li      t5, 6270
+        vmul.vx v12, v6, t5
+        vadd.vv v11, v11, v12
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v11, v11, t5
+        vsra.vi v11, v11, 14         /* t3a */
+        li      t5, 3196
+        vmul.vx v12, v1, t5
+        li      t5, 16069
+        vmul.vx v13, v7, t5
+        vsub.vv v12, v12, v13
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v12, v12, t5
+        vsra.vi v12, v12, 14         /* t4a */
+        li      t5, 13623
+        vmul.vx v13, v5, t5
+        li      t5, 9102
+        vmul.vx v14, v3, t5
+        vsub.vv v13, v13, v14
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v13, v13, t5
+        vsra.vi v13, v13, 14         /* t5a */
+        li      t5, 9102
+        vmul.vx v14, v5, t5
+        li      t5, 13623
+        vmul.vx v15, v3, t5
+        vadd.vv v14, v14, v15
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v14, v14, t5
+        vsra.vi v14, v14, 14         /* t6a */
+        li      t5, 16069
+        vmul.vx v15, v1, t5
+        li      t5, 3196
+        vmul.vx v16, v7, t5
+        vadd.vv v15, v15, v16
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v15, v15, t5
+        vsra.vi v15, v15, 14         /* t7a */
+        /* t0..t3, t4, t5a', t7, t6a' */
+        vadd.vv v17, v8,  v11        /* t0  = t0a+t3a */
+        vsub.vv v18, v8,  v11        /* t3  = t0a-t3a */
+        vadd.vv v19, v9,  v10        /* t1  = t1a+t2a */
+        vsub.vv v20, v9,  v10        /* t2  = t1a-t2a */
+        vadd.vv v21, v12, v13        /* t4  = t4a+t5a */
+        vsub.vv v13, v12, v13        /* t5a'= t4a-t5a */
+        vadd.vv v22, v15, v14        /* t7  = t7a+t6a */
+        vsub.vv v14, v15, v14        /* t6a'= t7a-t6a */
+        /* t5 = ((t6a'-t5a')*11585+8192)>>14 ; t6 = ((t6a'+t5a')*11585+8192)>>14 */
+        vsub.vv v23, v14, v13
+        li      t5, 11585
+        vmul.vx v23, v23, t5
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v23, v23, t5
+        vsra.vi v23, v23, 14         /* t5 */
+        vadd.vv v24, v14, v13
+        li      t5, 11585
+        vmul.vx v24, v24, t5
+        li      t5, 8192
+        vadd.vx v24, v24, t5
+        vsra.vi v24, v24, 14         /* t6 */
+        /* out */
+        vadd.vv v0,  v17, v22        /* out0 = t0+t7 */
+        vadd.vv v1,  v19, v24        /* out1 = t1+t6 */
+        vadd.vv v2,  v20, v23        /* out2 = t2+t5 */
+        vadd.vv v3,  v18, v21        /* out3 = t3+t4 */
+        vsub.vv v4,  v18, v21        /* out4 = t3-t4 */
+        vsub.vv v5,  v20, v23        /* out5 = t2-t5 */
+        vsub.vv v6,  v19, v24        /* out6 = t1-t6 */
+        vsub.vv v7,  v17, v22        /* out7 = t0-t7 */
+.endm
+
+/* DC-only path (eob == 1): t computed scalar, splat, accumulate.
+ * \sz: block size (8/16/32), \bits: output shift. */
+.macro vp9_dconly sz, bits
+        lh      t1, 0(a2)            /* block[0] */
+        li      t2, 11585
+        mul     t1, t1, t2
+        li      t2, 8192
+        add     t1, t1, t2
+        srai    t1, t1, 14
+        li      t2, 11585
+        mul     t1, t1, t2
+        li      t2, 8192
+        add     t1, t1, t2
+        srai    t1, t1, 14           /* t */
+        sh      zero, 0(a2)          /* block[0] = 0 */
+        li      t2, 1
+        slli    t2, t2, (\bits - 1)
+        add     t1, t1, t2
+        srai    t1, t1, \bits        /* delta */
+        vsetivli zero, \sz, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        mv      t0, a0
+        li      t3, \sz
+1:
+        vle8.v  v0, (t0)
+        vzext.vf2 v2, v0
+        vsetivli zero, \sz, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vadd.vx v2, v2, t1
+        vmax.vx v2, v2, zero
+        li      t4, 255
+        vmin.vx v2, v2, t4
+        vnsrl.wi v0, v2, 0          /* e16 -> e8 (run in e16 mode) */
+        vsetivli zero, \sz, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vse8.v  v0, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, a1
+        addi    t3, t3, -1
+        bnez    t3, 1b
+.endm
+
+/* Load 8 columns of the block as e16 vectors (vlse16, byte stride
+ * \stride = row stride) and widen to e32. */
+.macro vp9_ld_cols base, stride
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vlse16.v v0,  (\base), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 2
+        vlse16.v v1,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 4
+        vlse16.v v2,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 6
+        vlse16.v v3,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 8
+        vlse16.v v4,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 10
+        vlse16.v v5,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 12
+        vlse16.v v6,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 14
+        vlse16.v v7,  (t0), \stride
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v0,  v0
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v1,  v1
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v2,  v2
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v3,  v3
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4,  v4
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v5,  v5
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v6,  v6
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v7,  v7
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Store 8 e32 vectors (truncated to e16) column-wise to \base with byte
+ * stride \stride.  vnsrl.wi runs in e32 mode (source width). */
+.macro vp9_st_cols base, stride
+        vnsrl.wi v0,  v0, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v1,  v1, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v2,  v2, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v3,  v3, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v4,  v4, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v5,  v5, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v6,  v6, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v7,  v7, 0
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vsse16.v v0,  (\base), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 2
+        vsse16.v v1,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 4
+        vsse16.v v2,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 6
+        vsse16.v v3,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 8
+        vsse16.v v4,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 10
+        vsse16.v v5,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 12
+        vsse16.v v6,  (t0), \stride
+        add     t0, \base, 14
+        vsse16.v v7,  (t0), \stride
+.endm
+
+/* Load 8 rows (consecutive int16, row byte stride \stride) and widen.
+ * \stride is a register; offsets accumulated in t0. */
+.macro vp9_ld_rows base, stride
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vle16.v  v0,  (\base)
+        mv      t0, \base
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v1,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v2,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v3,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v4,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v5,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v6,  (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle16.v  v7,  (t0)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v0,  v0
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v1,  v1
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v2,  v2
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v3,  v3
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4,  v4
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v5,  v5
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v6,  v6
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v7,  v7
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* Accumulate shifted result rows into dst.  v0..v7 hold e32 results; the
+ * pass-2 outputs are int16 in C, so truncate to e16, sign-extend to e32,
+ * add (1<<(bits-1)), >>bits, then add to dst pixels (clip [0,255]).
+ * \base: dst, \stride: dst byte stride, \bits: output shift.
+ * Enters in e32 mode (after the butterfly).  vnsrl.wi / vzext.vf2 /
+ * vwcvt.x.x.v must run in the SOURCE width mode (sim reads self.vsew). */
+.macro vp9_add_dst base, stride, bits
+        /* e32 -> e16 truncation (int16 storage), still in e32 mode */
+        vnsrl.wi v0,  v0, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v1,  v1, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v2,  v2, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v3,  v3, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v4,  v4, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v5,  v5, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v6,  v6, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v7,  v7, 0
+        /* sign-extend e16 -> e32 for the shift */
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v0,  v0
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v1,  v1
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v2,  v2
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v3,  v3
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4,  v4
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v5,  v5
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v6,  v6
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v7,  v7
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e32, m1, ta, ma
+        li      t2, 1
+        slli    t2, t2, (\bits - 1)
+        vadd.vx v0,  v0, t2
+        vadd.vx v1,  v1, t2
+        vadd.vx v2,  v2, t2
+        vadd.vx v3,  v3, t2
+        vadd.vx v4,  v4, t2
+        vadd.vx v5,  v5, t2
+        vadd.vx v6,  v6, t2
+        vadd.vx v7,  v7, t2
+        vsra.vi v0,  v0, \bits
+        vsra.vi v1,  v1, \bits
+        vsra.vi v2,  v2, \bits
+        vsra.vi v3,  v3, \bits
+        vsra.vi v4,  v4, \bits
+        vsra.vi v5,  v5, \bits
+        vsra.vi v6,  v6, \bits
+        vsra.vi v7,  v7, \bits
+        /* back to e16 (values fit int16) */
+        vnsrl.wi v0,  v0, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v1,  v1, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v2,  v2, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v3,  v3, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v4,  v4, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v5,  v5, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v6,  v6, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v7,  v7, 0
+        /* load 8 dst rows (8 pixels each); \stride in register */
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vle8.v  v16, (\base)
+        mv      t0, \base
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v17, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v18, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v19, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v20, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v21, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v22, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vle8.v  v23, (t0)
+        /* zero-extend e8 -> e16 (in e8 source mode) */
+        vzext.vf2 v16, v16
+        vzext.vf2 v17, v17
+        vzext.vf2 v18, v18
+        vzext.vf2 v19, v19
+        vzext.vf2 v20, v20
+        vzext.vf2 v21, v21
+        vzext.vf2 v22, v22
+        vzext.vf2 v23, v23
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vadd.vv v16, v16, v0
+        vadd.vv v17, v17, v1
+        vadd.vv v18, v18, v2
+        vadd.vv v19, v19, v3
+        vadd.vv v20, v20, v4
+        vadd.vv v21, v21, v5
+        vadd.vv v22, v22, v6
+        vadd.vv v23, v23, v7
+        vmax.vx v16, v16, zero
+        vmax.vx v17, v17, zero
+        vmax.vx v18, v18, zero
+        vmax.vx v19, v19, zero
+        vmax.vx v20, v20, zero
+        vmax.vx v21, v21, zero
+        vmax.vx v22, v22, zero
+        vmax.vx v23, v23, zero
+        li      t4, 255
+        vmin.vx v16, v16, t4
+        vmin.vx v17, v17, t4
+        vmin.vx v18, v18, t4
+        vmin.vx v19, v19, t4
+        vmin.vx v20, v20, t4
+        vmin.vx v21, v21, t4
+        vmin.vx v22, v22, t4
+        vmin.vx v23, v23, t4
+        /* e16 -> e8 (in e16 mode) */
+        vnsrl.wi v16, v16, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v17, v17, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v18, v18, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v19, v19, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v20, v20, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v21, v21, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v22, v22, 0
+        vnsrl.wi v23, v23, 0
+        vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vse8.v  v16, (\base)
+        mv      t0, \base
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v17, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v18, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v19, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v20, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v21, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v22, (t0)
+        add     t0, t0, \stride
+        vse8.v  v23, (t0)
+.endm
+
+/* ff_vp9_idct_idct_8x8_add_rvv(uint8_t *dst, ptrdiff_t stride,
+ *                              int16_t *block, int eob) */
+func ff_vp9_idct_idct_8x8_add_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        li      t6, 1
+        beq     a3, t6, 2f           /* eob == 1: DC-only */
+        addi    sp, sp, -128
+        sd      s0, 0(sp)
+        sd      ra, 8(sp)
+        mv      s0, a0               /* dst */
+        mv      s1, a1               /* stride */
+        mv      s2, a2               /* block */
+        /* pass 1: load the block as ROW vectors; the lane-wise butterfly
+         * then applies the C column transform (IN(x) = block[x*8+i], i.e.
+         * one column spread across the vectors at lane i).  Results stored
+         * column-wise reproduce the C row-major intermediate tmp[] exactly
